name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
description: Measures red blood cells, white blood cells, hemoglobin, hematocrit, and platelets. Used to diagnose anemia, infections, inflammation, and blood disorders.

name: Lipid Profile (Full)
description: Measures Total Cholesterol, High-Density Lipoprotein (HDL), Low-Density Lipoprotein (LDL), and Triglycerides to assess cardiovascular risk and plaque build-up.

name: Thyroid Profile Total (T3, T4, TSH)
description: Evaluates thyroid gland function by measuring T3 (Triiodothyronine), T4 (Thyroxine), and Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH). Diagnoses hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism.

name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
description: Measures the average blood glucose levels over the past 2-3 months. Essential for screening, diagnosing, and monitoring Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes.

name: Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS)
description: Measures blood glucose levels after an overnight fast of at least 8 hours. Primary screening test for diabetes and prediabetes.

name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
description: Checks liver enzymes and proteins including Bilirubin, SGOT (AST), SGPT (ALT), Alkaline Phosphatase, and Albumin to detect liver disease, hepatitis, or jaundice.

name: Kidney Function Test (KFT)
description: Evaluates kidney health by measuring Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN), Serum Creatinine, Uric Acid, and serum electrolytes (Sodium, Potassium, Chloride).

name: Vitamin D Total (25-Hydroxy)
description: Measures Vitamin D concentration in blood. Important for bone health, calcium absorption, immunity, and diagnosing osteoporosis or chronic fatigue.

name: Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin)
description: Measures Vitamin B12 levels. Critical for nerve function, brain health, red blood cell formation, and diagnosing megaloblastic anemia.

name: Dengue Fever Panel (NS1 Antigen + IgG/IgM)
description: Detects early Dengue viral infection via NS1 antigen and later immune response via IgG/IgM antibodies. Essential during fever outbreaks.

name: Urine Routine & Microscopy (R/M)
description: Physical, chemical, and microscopic examination of urine to diagnose Urinary Tract Infections (UTIs), kidney stones, and protein leakage.

name: Executive Master Health Checkup Package
description: Comprehensive health screen including 65+ parameters: CBC, Lipid Profile, LFT, KFT, Thyroid Profile, HbA1c, FBS, Urine Routine, Vitamin D, and Vitamin B12.
